name: Unicentric Castleman Disease

criteria.description: Histopathological confirmation of lymph node showing characteristic features of Castleman disease (hyaline vascular or plasma cell variant)
Presence of a single enlarged lymph node or single region of lymph nodes without systemic involvement
Lack of systemic inflammatory symptoms such as fever, night sweats, or weight loss
Imaging studies (CT/MRI) demonstrating localized lymphadenopathy without widespread lymph node involvement

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation plus localized lymphadenopathy on imaging without systemic symptoms
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Exclusion of multicentric Castleman disease and other lymphoproliferative disorders is essential

pathognomonic.notes: Typically a solitary enlarged lymph node
searchTerms: painless swollen lymph nodes
localized lymph node enlargement without pain
non-tender lymph node swelling

pathognomonic.notes: Characteristic microscopic finding in most cases
searchTerms: hyaline vascular pattern on tissue exam
specific blood vessel changes in biopsy
vascular tissue changes seen microscopically

common.notes: Unlike multicentric Castleman disease, systemic symptoms are usually absent
searchTerms: no general symptoms like fatigue or weight loss
absence of overall illness signs
no constitutional symptoms present

common.symptomName: Mass effect symptoms due to lymph node enlargement
common.notes: Depending on lymph node location, may cause cough or dyspnea
searchTerms: symptoms from enlarged lymph nodes pressing on nearby structures
mass effect causing discomfort
pressure symptoms from lymph node swelling
high inflammation blood test results
elevated ESR or CRP levels
increased markers of inflammation

occasional.symptomName: Localized pain or tenderness at lymph node site
occasional.notes: May occur due to mass effect or inflammation
searchTerms: pain or tenderness over swollen lymph node
localized discomfort at lymph node site
sore lymph node area

occasional.notes: Rarely reported due to nerve compression

rare.symptomName: Renal dysfunction secondary to mass effect
rare.notes: Rarely lymph node compression affects renal structures
searchTerms: kidney problems caused by pressure from mass
renal dysfunction due to nearby mass effect
kidney impairment from compression

rare.notes: More typical of multicentric disease but rarely present
searchTerms: fever and weight loss as systemic symptoms
general signs of inflammation like fever
whole body inflammatory symptoms

laboratory: Normal or mildly elevated platelet count
imaging: CT or MRI showing solitary enlarged lymph node or localized lymphadenopathy
No evidence of widespread lymphadenopathy or organomegaly
genetic: No specific genetic mutations identified for unicentric Castleman disease
other: Histopathology showing hyaline vascular or plasma cell variant features
Negative HHV-8 and HIV serology (to exclude multicentric Castleman disease)

distinguishingFeatures: Positive HHV-8 or HIV in some cases
Usually associated with infection or inflammation
Resolves with treatment of underlying cause

redFlags: Systemic symptoms such as fever, night sweats, or weight loss
Evidence of organ dysfunction or compression symptoms
references: Fajgenbaum DC, et al. The Castleman Disease Collaborative Network diagnostic criteria. Blood. 2017.
